node.statement: The validated node 1.1.5, via its validated steps 1.1.5.1--1.1.5.2, proves the amended statement with kappa=C_ca and e_sq=e_ca: if S_P is nonzero, P is nonvanishing and lem-compcb-corner-algebra makes every M_n tensor S_P a C_ca*e-C*-algebra uniformly in n, so the product upper axiom and involution isometry give ||Z^dagger dot Z|| <= (1+C_ca*e)||Z||^2; if S_P=0, then Z=0 by node 1.1.1. These two exhaustive cases establish the claimed universal amplified square estimate.
